name: jevsight
description: Jevsight agent for Claude Code: /jevsight:agent runs a read-only research task over one of your MCP servers with Claude keeping the thinking and Jev (TypeSafe's calibrated classifier) taking the routine tool calls: about half the model turns, same answer. Also ships the earlier MCP proxy (bin/mcp_proxy.py) that runs Jev's predicted call early inside Claude Code.

api_key.title: Jev API key
api_key.description: OpenRouter or TypeSafe API key used for Jev predictions

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: vercel, openrouter or typesafe (default: whichever key is set)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shadow (predict and log only), on (run guesses early), or off

alpha.title: Waste price
alpha.description: How much a wasted worker-second costs relative to a saved second. Lower means more speculation.

extra_commands.title: Extra safe commands
extra_commands.description: Command prefixes that are safe to run early, such as npm test. Your Bash allow rules are used too.

model.title: Model for the agent
model.description: Anthropic model the agent calls (default claude-opus-5-5); needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment

threshold.title: Jev commit threshold
threshold.description: Jev makes the call itself when its top candidate has at least this probability
